cursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Copy it verbatim from the `next` continuation (or `next_cursor`) an identical prior call returned; never invent one or reuse one across a different query.

output_schema.description: The complete bounded Draft 2020-12 object schema enforced by the runner after output redaction. Present only for actions that opt into typed results.

structured_output.description: Runner-redacted output that passed the action's declared output schema.

reason.description: Human-readable justification for this action. Shown to human approvers and recorded in the audit log — state what you are doing and why (e.g. 'Restart stuck postgres on db-1 to clear a connection pileup'). A vague or placeholder reason slows approval.

evidence.description: Optional: what you already observed that makes this action necessary — prior findings, error signatures, or the run ids you inspected. State it so approvers and the audit log see the basis. Not verified.

expected.description: Optional: the outcome you expect if this action works — the hypothesis a follow-up check would confirm. Records what success looks like for approvers and the audit log. Not required and not verified.

timeout.description: Maximum time to block before returning the current state, as a duration string: "0", "30s", or "1500ms".

cursor.description: Opaque output-tail cursor. Do not construct or edit this; pass only the value from a prior response's `next`. Present it to stream a run's output forward from where you left off.

error_message.description: Fixed status classification of a settled outcome: a policy denial or a failed, refused, errored, invalid, unknown-action, or timed-out run. Never runner output, a recorded runner cause, a policy reason, an approver reason, or the caller's own reason; the recorded cause stays on the portal run page.

output.description: Forward delta of runner-redacted output after the cursor, in emission order; consecutive same-stream chunks are coalesced. Empty when nothing new has arrived yet.

output_complete.description: Present only when the runner or portal detected a missing progress chunk; the delta may then contain gaps. Complete output omits this field.

local_audit_failed.description: The runner could not persist the terminal or refusal event in its local audit journal. The action status remains authoritative.

structured_output_omitted.description: A structured result exists but was omitted intact to keep this response within its output budget.

enforce_signatures.description: True when this runner verifies a customer-CA action attestation before executing; dispatching to it needs a signing-enabled bridge.

error_message.description: Fixed status classification of a settled outcome: a policy denial or a failed, refused, errored, invalid, unknown-action, or timed-out run. Never runner output, a recorded runner cause, a policy reason, an approver reason, or the caller's own reason; the recorded cause stays on the portal run page.

stdout.description: Bounded UTF-8 preview of runner-redacted stdout. A stream that produced no bytes omits its preview, byte-count, and truncation fields entirely.

stderr.description: Bounded UTF-8 preview of runner-redacted stderr. A stream that produced no bytes omits its preview, byte-count, and truncation fields entirely.

emitted_stdout_bytes.description: Normalized, redacted stdout bytes emitted within the runner's output cap.

emitted_stderr_bytes.description: Normalized, redacted stderr bytes emitted within the runner's output cap.

output_complete.description: Present only when the runner or portal detected a missing progress chunk on a terminal run; the previews may then contain gaps. Complete output omits this field.

local_audit_failed.description: The runner could not persist the terminal or refusal event in its local audit journal. The action status remains authoritative.

structured_output_omitted.description: A structured result exists but was omitted intact to keep this multi-run response within its aggregate output budget.

list_packs.title: List packs
list_packs.description: List operator-trusted exact pack refs observed on in-scope runners, with their bounded action catalogs. The all view includes trusted but currently unavailable deployments; packs without current trust are omitted.

list_runners.title: List runners
list_runners.description: Inspect in-scope runners, connectivity, and compatibility issues for operator-trusted packs and actions. Use the exact returned runner_ref values for dispatch.

packs.description: Bare pack ids this runner has a trusted, descriptor-matched deployment for and can dispatch right now, deduplicated and sorted. Pack presence does not promise every action is executable; per-action availability lives in find_actions, get_action, and list_packs.

find_actions.title: Find actions
find_actions.description: Search runnable actions across every in-scope runner by operational task. Pass the task as `query`; one search covers the whole fleet, so do not repeat it per runner. Returns only actions you can run right now, ranked, without argument schemas — call get_action once for the chosen action_id and pack_ref and it returns every compatible runner. The exact filters only narrow a known target; `query` is the normal path.

query.description: The operational task to search for, as free text. This is the normal input; omit the exact filters unless narrowing a known target.

target.description: Human target query (host, cluster, service) restricting results to actions executable on at least one match. Mutually exclusive with runner_refs.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return, 1 through 15 (default 15). Omit unless you deliberately want fewer.

get_action.title: Get action
get_action.description: Get the exact argument schema, risk, side effects, and compatible runners for one action in one immutable pack_ref. Call this before run_action.

run_action.title: Run action
run_action.description: Run one exact action on explicit runner_refs through Emisar scope, policy, approval, audit, and signed runner verification. The selected action may be destructive; inspect it with get_action first. Emisar evaluates policy and handles any required human approval.

wait.description: Maximum time to block before returning the current state, as a duration string: "0", "30s", or "1500ms".

get_operation.title: Get operation
get_operation.description: Look up one exact mutation by an operation_id already returned or recorded by the client. Returns a typed action, runbook, or draft continuation without repeating the mutation.

wait_for_run.title: Wait for run
wait_for_run.description: Wait for one run or runbook execution to change state, finish, or reach the timeout. Observation never cancels or repeats infrastructure work.

recent_runs.title: Recent runs
recent_runs.description: Inspect and paginate scoped run history by operation, runbook execution, step, runner, action, or pack. Use get_operation, not history absence, to reconcile an ambiguous mutation.

list_runbooks.title: List runbooks
list_runbooks.description: List visible immutable published runbooks with concise input, stage, and step counts. Use get_runbook to inspect the canonical definition before execution.

get_runbook.title: Get runbook
get_runbook.description: Get one exact immutable published runbook by runbook_ref. Metadata stays separate from the canonical typed definition used by authoring and execution.

execute_runbook.title: Execute runbook
execute_runbook.description: Execute one exact published runbook_ref through Emisar scope, policy, approval, and audit. A runbook may contain destructive steps; inspect it with get_runbook first. Emisar evaluates policy and handles any required human approval.

create_runbook_draft.title: Create runbook draft
create_runbook_draft.description: Validate and save a proposed runbook draft for human review. Invalid definitions return exact issue paths and are not persisted. This neither publishes the runbook nor executes any action.
